Proof in the paper: HRTEM images of Pd/MgO–Al2O3 and Pd–Ga/MgO–Al2O3 catalysts (Fig. 7) show that the metal nanoparticles uniformly distribute on the surface of the support. The lattice structure of the monometallic Pd, bimetallic Pd–Ga(2:1), and Pd–Ga(1:5) is discerned with 0.222 nm, 0.219 nm, and 0.218 nm, which are close to the lattice spacing measured for Pd(1 1 1) (JCPDS 46-1043), Pd2Ga(0 1 3) (JCPDS 65-1511), and PdGa5(2 1 3) facet (JCPDS 15-0577).
